edges.reason: from parameter is consumed by _transfer for balance and pair comparisons.
to parameter is consumed by _transfer for bot and pair checks.
amount parameter drives the _maxTxAmount comparison and token math.
transfer uses _msgSender() as the source of the transfer.
msg.sender-derived owner comparison gates the fee/bot branch in _transfer.
block.timestamp is written into the cooldown mapping, creating timestamp dependency.
block.timestamp controls cooldown enforcement inside _transfer.
_feeAddr1 fee percentage is read and assigned inside _transfer.
_feeAddr2 fee percentage is read and assigned inside _transfer.
uniswapV2Pair is compared against from/to inside _transfer.
_maxTxAmount bounds the transfer amount in _transfer.
inSwap guard is checked before triggering the auto-swap.
swapEnabled gates the auto-liquify branch in _transfer.
cooldown mapping value is validated against block.timestamp in _transfer.
_transfer invokes swapTokensForEth before finishing token accounting.
_transfer invokes sendETHToFee which performs external ETH transfers.
swapTokensForEth calls the external Uniswap router swap function.
sendETHToFee performs external transfers to fee wallets.
_feeAddrWallet1 receives half of the distributed ETH.
_feeAddrWallet2 receives half of the distributed ETH.
uniswapV2Router is used as the swap target in swapTokensForEth.
manualswap authorizes the caller against _feeAddrWallet1.
_feeAddrWallet1 is compared to msg.sender in manualswap.
manualsend authorizes the caller against _feeAddrWallet1.
_feeAddrWallet1 is compared to msg.sender in manualsend.
_reflectFee subtracts the reflection fee from _rTotal.
openTrading is restricted by the onlyOwner modifier.
uniswapV2Router is assigned in openTrading.
openTrading calls addLiquidityETH forwarding contract ETH.
openTrading calls factory createPair.
openTrading approves the pair token to the router.
External ETH transfer can re-enter _transfer via receive/fallback before state settles.
Router swap into pair can trigger token callbacks re-entering swapTokensForEth path.
transferFrom uses _msgSender() as the spender for allowance deduction.
sender parameter drives the allowance lookup in transferFrom.
recipient parameter is forwarded to _transfer in transferFrom.
amount is subtracted from allowance using SafeMath in transferFrom.
_allowances is read and updated in transferFrom.
tokenAmount parameter determines the swap input size.
amount parameter determines ETH split in sendETHToFee.
tAmount drives all reflection and fee math in _transferStandard.
approve uses _msgSender() as the owner argument.
bots_ array is iterated to flag blacklisted addresses.
setBots writes into the bots mapping.
notbot address is cleared in the bots mapping.
delBot writes into the bots mapping.
onoff parameter is written into cooldownEnabled.
setCooldownEnabled mutates cooldownEnabled.
rAmount is divided by the current rate in tokenFromReflection.

normalization_plan.reason: from is a parameter only meaningful inside _transfer's dataflow.
to is a parameter only meaningful inside _transfer's dataflow.
amount parameterizes _transfer's amount and max-tx checks.
sender is consumed by transferFrom for allowance handling.
recipient is forwarded by transferFrom to _transfer.
amountFrom is subtracted from allowance inside transferFrom.
tokenAmount sizes the router swap call in swapTokensForEth.
amountEth is split between fee wallets in sendETHToFee.
tAmount drives the reflection math in _transferStandard.
owner_ indexes the allowance mapping in _approve.
spender_ indexes the allowance mapping in _approve.
amountApprove is stored into the allowance mapping by _approve.
rAmount is divided by the rate inside tokenFromReflection.
onoff is assigned to cooldownEnabled.
bots_ is iterated to populate the bots mapping.
notbot is cleared in the bots mapping.
contractTokenBalance is the local swap input derived in _transfer.
contractETHBalance is the local ETH cache checked in _transfer.
path is the local swap route built in swapTokensForEth.
currentRate is the local rate computed for tokenFromReflection.
tFee is the local fee produced by _getTValues.
tTeam is the local team fee produced by _getTValues.
